title: Missing monitoring data
prompt: You want to be notified when a health metric that should be sent every minute stops being sent. What CloudWatch alarm setting should be used when the data remains missing?

choices.explanation: This includes the state in which observations have stopped in the evaluation of a threshold breach.

choices.text: Treat missing data as not breaching
choices.explanation: The monitored system may be judged healthy even when it can no longer send the metric.
This does not eliminate the need for an evaluation period or determine how missing data is handled.

learning.reason: Treating missing data as breaching includes the state in which observations have stopped in the evaluation of a threshold breach.
learning.concept: The meaning of missing data depends on the metric. For a metric emitted only during abnormal conditions, treating missing data as not breaching may be appropriate.

title: Connecting Without a Bastion Host
prompt: We want to control who can access an EC2 shell through IAM without allowing inbound SSH. What is appropriate?

choices.explanation: This collects records of network traffic but does not provide shell connectivity.
This increases bastion host and network management and maintains an SSH path.
It opens a session to the managed node, so a continuously open SSH port is not required.

learning.reason: It opens a session to the managed node, so a continuously open SSH port is not required.
learning.concept: SSM Agent, an IAM role for the instance, and a network path to Systems Manager are required.

title: Recovering from an Incorrect Update
prompt: An RDS table was incorrectly updated at 14:00. What should you do to compare its 13:59 contents without stopping the production database?

choices.explanation: Restarting does not restore data that was incorrectly updated.

choices.text: Create a separate database using point-in-time recovery
choices.explanation: A new database can be restored to a specified time within the backup range.
The update is replicated to the standby, so this does not restore the database to an earlier point in time.

learning.reason: A new database can be restored to a specified time within the backup range.
learning.concept: PITR and high-availability failover are separate features. Check the backup retention period and the latest restorable time.

title: Detecting Missing Tags
prompt: After EC2 instances are created, we want to continuously detect resources that do not have required tags. What should we use?

choices.explanation: They evaluate resource configurations and can identify resources that do not comply with defined settings.
CPU values do not determine whether tags are present.
These alert on spending and do not check for required configuration tags.

learning.reason: They evaluate resource configurations and can identify resources that do not comply with defined settings.
learning.concept: AWS Config is responsible for detecting and evaluating configuration. If creation itself must be prevented, consider a separate preventive control for the relevant action.

title: Differences from the Existing Stack
prompt: We want to check whether supported resources managed by CloudFormation were manually modified in the console. What is appropriate?

choices.text: Only create a change set from the same template
choices.explanation: Creating a change set alone does not list differences from the actual configuration.
This controls the scope of permitted updates; it does not detect configuration differences.
It can detect differences between the expected properties and the actual values.

learning.reason: It can detect differences between the expected properties and the actual values.
learning.concept: Drift detection applies to supported properties; running detection alone does not correct the differences.

title: Notifications and Automatic Recovery
prompt: You want to monitor EC2 memory utilization for each instance. What should you do if the standard metrics do not include the required data?

choices.explanation: VPC Flow Logs record network flows; they do not collect memory usage from inside the operating system.

choices.text: Send guest operating system memory metrics using the CloudWatch Agent
choices.explanation: The CloudWatch Agent can collect metrics from the guest operating system as additional metrics.

choices.text: Enable only detailed monitoring for EC2
choices.explanation: Detailed monitoring changes the granularity of standard metrics but does not add guest operating system memory information.

learning.reason: Guest operating system metrics can be collected as additional metrics.
learning.concept: During analysis, also check the collection interval, dimensions, and the agent's IAM permissions.
